speaker: johan_vosloo
headline: ORDER IS A SEQUENCE, NOT A SLOGAN.
deck: A functioning institution moves from rule to role, enforcement and appeal without losing responsibility along the way.
quote: Predictability is built when every step has a place, an owner and a route for correction.
facts: Roles determine who acts and who answers.
Appeal keeps correction inside the institution.
takeaway: Institutional order is credible when citizens can see the route from rule to remedy.
